specs.criterion: Senior architect and software scientist role must be explicit.
Interrogator must issue a focused question, wait, evaluate an actual answer, and continue when material gaps remain.
Distinct interlocutors and actual runtime references; no fabricated skill-assistant dialogue.
Assistant cannot decide missing human business policy or upgrade its inference to confirmed intent.
No READY with missing interview, open question, uncovered material dimension or unresolved contradiction.
Transcript records skill-role question and assistant answer verbatim, with evidence and disposition.
Every relevant architectural review records MCP-first and skills-first research and primary web exploration or actual tool failures.
Design improvements require alternatives, evaluation criteria, tradeoffs, falsifier and explicit proposed/accepted/rejected status.
Interrupted, paused, missing-runtime and unanswered states are fail-closed; one question at a time, not a fixed total.
Source QA files remain hash-identical; legacy PRD cannot claim the new interrogation completed.
Every transcript/reference ID is unique and resolves; rejection counterexamples retained.
Installed links and skill registry point at repaired source; real bounded multi-turn role smoke test and native RDD evidence.
